description: Implementation of the LocalStore class handling database operations such as opening, creating tables, setting limits, adding, retrieving, and removing entries, using a DatabaseConnection object within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Manages database connection and operations such as creating tables, setting limits, adding, retrieving, and deleting entries in a SQLite database, within WPEFramework.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens or reuses a database connection for the specified path, creating a database file if needed.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database with an auto-incremented id and data column.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum page count limit for the database.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count and starting id of entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries (data field values) from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Deletes entries in a table between specified start and end ids.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Inserts a new data entry into a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs SQL query strings for retrieving events with optional start and count parameters.
